run_query_definition: the benchmark's expert-aligned English rendering (an oracle-style upper bound; used by the retired Fig. 6 and kept here as a control)
retention: every intermediate artefact is persisted: per-question query list, merged dense/BM25 hit streams with scores, fused ranking (top 60), the candidate window with chunk text, the reranked order with scores, the dynamic threshold, the passed set and the gold ids (pools_*.jsonl + rerank_*.jsonl + cond_*.json)
params: W=20 K=10 rrf_k=60 beta=0.60 floor=0.25 top_k_vector=40 top_k_bm25=40

rerank_settings.original: rerank with the user's question (paradigm condition; production behaviour)
rerank_settings.qs0: rerank with the first composed query (as-shipped legacy behaviour; what Fig. 6 measured)

zh_condition: raw_zh reranks both settings with the Chinese question; for a query-language manipulation the query must stay the same in both stages, so the two settings coincide by construction
note: pool built once per (condition, question) and reused for both rerank settings, so the two settings differ in exactly one variable
